title: Support and Resistance
description: The invisible floors and ceilings of the market.

slides.title: Support (The Floor)
slides.content: Support is a price level where a stock struggles to fall below. It's where buyers historically step in and think 'Wow, this is too cheap!' and start buying.

slides.title: Resistance (The Ceiling)
slides.content: Resistance is a price level a stock struggles to break above. It's where sellers historically say 'Wow, this is expensive!' and start selling.

slides.title: Breakouts
slides.content: If a stock finally smashes through a Resistance ceiling, it's called a 'Breakout'. That old ceiling often becomes the new floor (Support)!

quiz.question: A price level that a stock historically struggles to fall below is called...

options.explanation: Support acts as a floor holding the price up.

quiz.question: When a stock pushes past a major Resistance level, it is known as a...

options.explanation: Breaking through resistance is a bullish sign called a breakout.
